release.body:
## SECURITY

* auth/cert: Add resolve path canonicalization to CRL paths. GHSA-736f-82w7-hj22. [[GH-4323](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4323)]
* secrets/approle: Add resolve path canonicalization in Role ID paths. GHSA-736f-82w7-hj22. [[GH-4323](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4323)]
* secrets/identity: Ensure `client_type=public` is denied with `client_credentials=true` in the OIDC provider. GHSA-q824-44ff-f5j5. [[GH-4323](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4323)]
* secrets/ssh: Deny wildcards (`*`) in SSH certificate identity templating by default. Configurable via the `allow_wildcards_in_identity_templates` parameter. GHSA-h76r-48x5-36hg. [[GH-4323](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4323)]
* secrets/transit: Ensure imported key backup does not allow clobbering arbitrary keys through path traversal. GHSA-5pmx-2p74-x478. [[GH-4323](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4323)]

## IMPROVEMENTS

* ui: Add fields to configure external keys in PKI. [[GH-4306](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4306)]

## BUG FIXES

* core: Fix rate limit exempt paths being unresponsive during post-unseal. [[GH-4293](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4293)]
* core: Fix sudo-capable tokens failing sudo checks on their final use. [[GH-4158](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4158)]
* core/plugins: Fix transactions started by external plugins failing when using the PostgreSQL storage backend. [[GH-4177](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4177)]
* core/plugins: Ensure plugin backend reloading with `scope=global` actually performs a cluster-wide reload. [[GH-4221](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4221)]
* core/plugins: Avoid immediate plugin reloads on standbys after tuning a mount's version and wait for a direct node-local or `scope=global` reload instead. [[GH-4221](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4221)]
* core/namespaces: Fix namespace deletion failing after upgrading to v2.7.x from an earlier version. [[GH-4201](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4201)]
* auth/oidc: Fix login in direct callback mode by including the namespace in the redirect URI. [[GH-4199](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4199)]
* secrets/pki: Fix intermediate CSR generation for type `kms` not using the provided external key and generating an internally-stored private key instead. [[GH-4309](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4309)]
* kms/transit: Respect the `version` parameter when exporting a public key instead of fetching the latest version's one. [[GH-4297](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4297)]
* ui: Fix blank "key bits" dropdown when generating an ML-DSA key in PKI. [[GH-4305](https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4305)]

<details>
<summary>

## What's Changed

</summary>

* Do not attempt singleton mount backend reloads (#4201 by @wslabosz-reply) backported by @phil9909 in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4247
* Fix gRPC transaction context (#4177 by @satoqz) backported by @phil9909 in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4248
* Fix: include missing namespace in OIDC direct callback (#4199 by @plnryv-reply) backported by @satoqz in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4274
* Fix `sudo`-enforced request handling with single-use tokens (#4158 by @wslabosz-reply) backported by @satoqz in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4276
* Improve backend reloading across a cluster (#4221 by @satoqz) backported by @satoqz in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4275
* Backport dependencies, bump Go on v2.7.x by @satoqz in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4313
* Update favicon mime type to image/svg+xml (#4303 by @ranneetcodes2020-create) backported by @satoqz in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4310
* Bump container base images (#4312 by @satoqz) backported by @satoqz in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4316
* Do not block sys/health while a standby becomes active (#4293 by @JAYKRISHNAN) backported by @satoqz in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4298
* Update PKI UI for external keys (#4306 by @satoqz) backported by @satoqz in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4318
* Fix ML-DSA key bits dropdown (#4305 by @satoqz) backported by @satoqz in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4319
* Fix PKI intermediate + external keys (#4309 by @satoqz) backported by @satoqz in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4315
* Bump github.com/openbao/go-kms-wrapping/kms/transit/v2 from 2.1.0 to 2.1.1 (#4297 by @satoqz) backported by @satoqz in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4321
* Address security issues for v2.7.2 - release/2.7.x branch (#4323 by @cipherboy) backported by @cipherboy in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4324
* Add release notes for v2.7.2 by @satoqz in https://github.com/openbao/openbao/pull/4326

</details>

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openbao/openbao/compare/v2.7.1...v2.7.2
